editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the ServiceNow Universal Request Accreditation exam featuring 18 questions across 5 official domains covering overview, configuration, workspace.
editorial.overview: The ServiceNow Universal Request Accreditation exam is a linear assessment designed to evaluate your knowledge across exactly 18 questions utilizing multiple choice and multiple select formats. It covers Universal Request fundamentals, configuration, Agent Workspace integration, virtual agent conversations, and reporting solutions to ensure a thorough understanding across all 5 official domains.
editorial.who_should_take: ServiceNow administrators, implementers, and support professionals who configure, manage, or utilize Universal Request applications within ServiceNow environments should take this accreditation exam to validate their technical expertise.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review official ServiceNow documentation and exam guides carefully. Focus your study on Universal Request data models, guided setup for services, and dashboard overview configurations. Practice navigating Agent Workspace and virtual agent conversation workflows to ensure complete coverage of all 5 domains during your structured study sessions.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Read each question carefully and note whether multiple choices or multiple selections are required. Manage your time efficiently across all 18 questions on this linear exam.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam consists of exactly 18 questions presented in a linear format. Candidates encounter multiple choice and multiple select questions covering all 5 domains during the evaluation process.
The passing score uses a scaled score model. The exact cut score is not publicly disclosed by ServiceNow and is not always set to 70% for candidates taking this accreditation.
Exam duration details are not specified in the official documentation, so you should check with ServiceNow for current timing policies and testing rules before you begin your assessment.
The exam is included with ServiceNow University access. Check with ServiceNow directly for any updated or separate pricing notes regarding your specific account and learning path requirements.

methodology.summary: This page was carefully built using verified facts and official exam documentation sourced directly from official ServiceNow platforms to ensure absolute accuracy and reliable guidance.
